description: Use this to set or change the signed-in person's profile, which decides what their feed shows. It overwrites the saved value of every field it is given and keeps every field it is not given. Values are the ids from profile_options; an unknown id is refused with the reason. A list field is replaced as a whole (the full list of cities, not just the new one). completed=true marks onboarding finished, so the web app skips it.

categories.description: Category paths from profile_options, e.g. engineering/software/backend.

cities.description: City names; synonyms match (bangalore finds Bengaluru).

education.description: Highest qualification held or being studied for.

exp.description: [min, max] years of experience wanted, e.g. [0, 2].

location_countries.description: Country codes to work in: in, us, uk, de, sg, ...

modes.description: Work mode preference; office includes hybrid.

pay.description: [min, max] expected pay in thousands per year.

routes.description: How they could take a job: where already authorised, with visa sponsorship, or remote across borders.

work_auth.description: Country code -> statuses held there, e.g. {"in": ["citizen"], "us": ["need_sponsorship"]}.

name: update_my_profile
title: Update your profile
